followup.intro: The task's literal intro_commit_sha cda418a4a5a23699956dbcd06ba369405a190821 is commit 1/4 of a 4-part series ('[autofit] Speed up computation of af_reverse_character_map_new'). At that single commit afgsub.c is added but is DEAD CODE: nothing calls af_parse_gsub/af_map_lookup, and the file itself fails to compile standalone (7 clang errors: `no member named 'gsub'/'gsub_length'/'gsub_lookups_single_alternate' in struct AF_FaceGlobalsRec_`, since those struct fields are only added in part 2/4). Independently confirmed this build failure myself (not just trusting the prior anypoc run) -- see artifacts/intro_build_failure.log. The defect becomes reachable at commit 6a982bde8 (part 4/4, the first commit that calls af_map_lookup, confirmed via `git log -S af_map_lookup -- src/autofit/afadjust.c`) and remains present through 53b9319bff2deaa24eb6d29da7a304ac8c8e42a8^ (=36f917cc6ac8b3b0c9cbc549fab2f839f6f5680b), the commit immediately preceding the task's own fix_commit. Built 36f917cc6 with ASan (clean full build, git worktree). Running the PoC against it produced AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow: READ of size 1, 0 bytes right of a 98-byte heap region, stack af_coverage_iterator (afgsub.c:446) <- af_map_single_subst1 (afgsub.c:546) <- af_map_lookup (afgsub.c:670) <- af_reverse_character_map_new (afadjust.c:1440) <- af_latin_metrics_init <- af_face_globals_get_metrics <- af_loader_load_glyph <- af_autofitter_load_glyph <- FT_Load_Glyph <- main; allocation site af_parse_gsub (afgsub.c:325). This is exactly the labelled defect (lookupType clobbered by a nested extension-lookup subtable, causing the next subtable in the same lookup to be mis-parsed).
followup.benign: 53b9319bff2deaa24eb6d29da7a304ac8c8e42a8 (task's fix_commit, matches exactly). Rather than a clean rebuild, reused the already-built vulnerable tree (36f917cc6) per the incremental-compile rule: `git checkout 53b9319bff2deaa24eb6d29da7a304ac8c8e42a8 -- src/autofit/afgsub.c` (8-line diff, introduces a per-iteration `real_lookupType` -- byte-for-byte the same fix shown in the ground-truth JSON's suggestion_code) followed by `cmake --build build -j8`, which only recompiled autofit.c and relinked. Running the same PoC + same poc.ttf against the patched build: prints 'done', exit 0, no ASan report.
